title: SEC2: Regex recompilation in glob/regex matchers causes CPU waste
description: In evaluator.rs, str_matches_glob() and str_matches_regex() call fancy_regex::Regex::new() on every match attempt, even for identical patterns. For scripts evaluated multiple times or with many glob patterns tested against many header values, this causes redundant regex compilations. Consider: (1) Pre-compile patterns when the script is evaluated, storing in evaluation context, or (2) Use a simple LRU cache of recently compiled regexes keyed by pattern+flags. This is not O(n²) but O(M × P) waste where M=header values, P=patterns. Typical impact: low, but high in pathological scripts with many globs.
